question: The fourth proportional of a, c and bc is d. The fourth proportional of (bc²)/(a), (ad)/(c) and c is _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any four values in proportion: Product of extremes = Product of means.

From the first proportion (a, c, bc, d): a × d = c × bc ⇒ ad = bc²

Let the required fourth proportional be x.

From the second proportion (bc²/a, ad/c, c, x): (bc²/a) × x = (ad/c) × c

⇒ (bc²/a) × x = ad ⇒ (bc²/a) × x = bc² ⇒ x = a

**∴ The correct answer is a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First set of proportional values = a, c, bc, d

Second set of proportional values = bc²/a, ad/c, c, x (where x is the fourth proportional)

**Formula Used:**

If p, q, r, s are in proportion, then p : q :: r : s ⇒ p × s = q × r

**Calculations:**

⇒ According to the rule of proportion for the first set: a × d = c × bc

⇒ ad = bc² ... (Equation 1)

⇒ According to the rule of proportion for the second set: (bc²/a) × x = (ad/c) × c

⇒ (bc²/a) × x = ad

⇒ Substitute ad = bc² from Equation 1 into the above expression:

⇒ (bc²/a) × x = bc²

⇒ x / a = 1

⇒ x = a

**∴ The correct answer is a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then d is the fourth proportional. It is calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional. It is calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product. It is calculated as √(a × b).
